# M0-S2: plain .lgo package runs and builds under logos; plain go ignores it.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# logos runs the .lgo package.
logos run .
stdout '^hello$'

# logos builds it.
logos build .

# Plain go sees no Go files in a .lgo-only package.
! go build .
stderr 'no Go files'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/hello

go 1.27

-- main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("hello")
}
